summary: Manchester United plc filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim report for the three and nine months ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine quarterly financial disclosure by a foreign private issuer, covering management discussion, financial statements, and forward-looking statements. There is no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other corporate event. The filing serves only to update the market on the company's financial condition and results. No deal terms, advisor recommendations, or structural changes are discussed.
